senses.definition: the act of creating written works
examples: writing was a form of therapy for him
it was a matter of disputed authorship

senses.definition: the work of a writer; anything expressed in letters of the alphabet (especially when considered from the point of view of style and effect)
examples: the writing in her novels is excellent
that editorial was a fine piece of writing

senses.definition: (usually plural) the collected work of an author
examples: the idea occurs with increasing frequency in Hemingway's writings

senses.definition: letters or symbols that are written or imprinted on a surface to represent the sounds or words of a language
examples: he turned the paper over so the writing wouldn't show

senses.definition: the activity of putting something in written form
examples: she did the thinking while he did the writing
